title: AnalysesDocument
description: MongoDB `analyses` collection document. Unique index on analysis_id; secondary indexes on conversation_id and parent_analysis_id for §84 scenario chains. §99.1. DELIBERATE DEVIATION from §99.1's exact bullet list: the doc lists detected_language/override_language/response_language/primary_intent/secondary_intents/location/time_window/activity/vessel_type/selected_agents/skipped_agents/sampling as separate top-level fields alongside a 'planner_result'. This schema keeps them ONLY inside the nested 'plan' (ExecutionPlan.json) rather than also denormalizing copies to the top level, because a duplicate copy is a second source of truth that can drift from the nested original — the exact class of bug this whole contract set exists to prevent. MongoDB can index into 'plan.primary_intent' etc. directly without a flat duplicate. agent_statuses/data_quality/execution_trace/updated_at ARE added below as genuinely new fields, not denormalized duplicates of anything already in 'plan'.

analysis_id.description: RESOLVED: req_{YYYYMMDD}_{HHMM}_{hash6}, receipt time in UTC. See api/AnalysisExecutionRequest.json for full rationale. Unique index.

plan.description: Corresponds to §99.1's 'planner_result' field. Null until the Planner stage completes.

agent_statuses.description: Persisted live agent-status trace — §99.1 explicitly lists this; it was missing from earlier drafts of this document. Same shape as api/AnalysisStatusResponse.json's agent_statuses[].

data_quality.description: §99.1 explicitly lists this at the document level, not just inside Decision/RiskAssessment — was missing from earlier drafts.

execution_trace.description: §99.1, §100. Was missing from earlier drafts — previously only appeared in api/AnalysisResultResponse.json, but §99.1 requires it persisted here too.

updated_at.description: §99.1 lists created_at/updated_at/completed_at — updated_at was missing from earlier drafts. Bumped on every write to this document.
